notes: v588 — CARD SETTINGS APPLY THEMSELVES. Changing the hold window (5d/10d/30d) or the 💧 floor inside the 📋 report card used to update only the card — the radar and table behind it kept the old answer until something else nudged them. Now: a new hold window re-asks the server immediately (strip flips to ⏳ with the live timer before the card is even closed), and a floor tap repaints the main screen instantly — and because of v586's one ruler, a floor tap no longer throws away the day's graded answer or costs a server trip at all. Exit the card and everything already matches. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
